sections.name: summary
sections.value: The user surface. Key research fact: source_kind is the VECTOR-SPACE axis (raw|smart, CHECK-constrained, job-parsed) -- conversation is NOT a third value on it but an orthogonal content-type filter on elements.kind. The CLI keeps workshop 003s one user-facing --source axis by MAPPING conversation to that filter. Coordinate with w-get-verb (in flight): it builds the conv: dispatch arm returning NOT-IMPLEMENTED; this phase replaces that arm.

value.title: flowspace3 conversation import <file|-> : our JSONL shape (documented); mints/accepts GUID; anchor from cwd git context or flags; RE-IMPORT of a grown file appends only new turns (the iterative contract, proven in a test); claude/omp dialect adapters live in the importer only

conversation list + remove verbs (Jordan 2026-08-27): list with anchor filters (--repo, --path prefix) showing guid, title, turn count, started_at, anchor; remove <guid> deletes conversation + turns + element rows and normal gc reclaims the chain -- symmetric with repo remove; both JSON envelopes

search --source conversation: accepts it, maps to a content-type filter -- SearchFilters gains kind (embeddings.rs:292), predicate bound in BOTH the nearest CTE and the element-resolution LATERAL (critic finding 4: resolver picks lowest-id element per raw_hash, so a deduped turn can resolve to a code element without the second predicate); default source=all keeps EXCLUDING turns; conv: arm in address_of (search.rs:274); recency-leaning rank for turns; test: hit on shared turn text resolves to a turn element

Windowed fetch + outline: fill the conv: arm (get conv:<guid>#t<ord> --before N --after M) if w-get-verb landed, else flowspace3 conversation show with the same contract; tree conv:<guid> returns the outline

Docs + register: docs/services/conversations.md; bundled docs + agents-start-here gain the conversation loop; configuration.md rows for the size gate; PRD req-0024/0025/0026 checked with evidence via ddocs, req-0027 note updated (surface shipped, capture deferred)

DOGFOOD EXIT PROOF: import a real fleet transcript, grow it with a second import (iterative), semantic-search a known moment, window around the hit; run transcript recorded in the plan folder as exit evidence
